nodes.label: MedWare Postgres Schema
nodes.rationale: Generated by introspecting the live Postgres database with pg_dump --schema-only rather than hand-drafted, so it documents the actually-migrated schema; it was reconciled 1:1 against the earlier hand-drafted medware_schema_3.sql draft.

nodes.label: Mermaid Sync Cooperation Rule
nodes.rationale: Diagrams managed by the Mermaid Chart GitHub Sync app must not be manually rewritten, and the user must be warned before Repair because it consumes Mermaid AI credits - both guard against silently clobbering managed state or spending the user's credits.

nodes.label: Validate-Before-Present Rule
nodes.rationale: Every diagram must pass mermaid-diagram-validator before being shown and never be returned as unvalidated syntax, so broken diagrams never reach the user; diagrams are written to .mmd files rather than inlined.

nodes.label: Atomic Transactional Business Logic
nodes.rationale: Order finalization, return approval adjustments, supplier bill processing and commission calculation must run inside atomic transactions because each mutates several tables whose partial application would leave financial state inconsistent.

nodes.label: Audit Persistence Requirement
nodes.rationale: Every workflow transition must persist both an AuditLog and a RequestTransition record, making the audit trail a hard requirement of each state change rather than optional instrumentation.

nodes.label: related_name Reverse Accessor Clash
nodes.rationale: related_name values must be unique across apps or Django raises reverse accessor clashes; inventory.SupplierBill.supplier was renamed to inventory_bills to resolve one such collision.

nodes.label: Role-Based Permissions
nodes.rationale: Write operations on products, suppliers, categories and bills are restricted to the MANAGER role; non-managers receive 403 Forbidden. The frontend is told to confirm access via both the users/access/... probes and the role-specific viewsets rather than trusting a locally cached role.

nodes.label: psycopg 3 Driver Pin
nodes.rationale: Pinned to psycopg[binary] 3.3.4 because that is the driver actually installed in the venv and the one Django 6 targets; the file previously pinned psycopg2-binary, which was never installed - the pins are deliberately kept in sync with the running environment via pip freeze.

nodes.label: User Role Column
nodes.rationale: Roles live as a varchar_30 column on users_user rather than through Django auth groups, which is why permission checks throughout the API compare against a role string instead of group membership.

nodes.label: Cookie-Based Refresh Flow
nodes.rationale: The refresh route reads the refresh token from the cookie instead of the request body, so the frontend can obtain a new access token without ever storing the refresh token in client-side JavaScript.

nodes.label: Email-Based Login
nodes.rationale: The token serializer resolves a user by email OR username so existing username-based clients keep working while email login is added - backward compatibility was an explicit constraint.

nodes.label: Token Route 404 Failure
nodes.rationale: POST /api/auth/token/ returned a Django 404 debug page listing only auth/register/ in the URLconf, so at the time this smoke run was captured the token route documented in the README and JWT draft was not wired into mysite.urls.

nodes.label: Dark Mode Design Tokens
nodes.rationale: Body classes pair light-* and dark:dark-* semantic token names (background-primary, text-primary), indicating a Tailwind class-based dark mode with a named token palette rather than raw color utilities.

nodes.label: MedWare Bolt Brand Mark
nodes.rationale: A 48x46 lightning-bolt/chevron glyph in violet (#863bff, with a display-p3 wide-gamut fill fallback pair) over a masked pale-lilac gradient ellipse; the duplicated path inside an alpha mask is the standard trick for clipping the glow to the glyph silhouette.

nodes.label: SVG Icon Sprite Sheet
nodes.rationale: A single SVG containing multiple <symbol> definitions (bluesky, discord, documentation, github) referenced by id, so the app loads one sprite file and instantiates icons via <use> rather than shipping a file per icon. Brand glyphs use solid #08060d fills while UI glyphs use violet #aa3bff strokes - two distinct icon styles in one sheet.

nodes.label: HttpOnly Refresh Cookie
nodes.rationale: The refresh cookie is HttpOnly so client-side JS cannot read it, SameSite=Lax to blunt CSRF, and Secure is enabled outside DEBUG so production requires HTTPS while local development over http still works.

nodes.label: Dual JWT and Session Authentication
nodes.rationale: DEFAULT_AUTHENTICATION_CLASSES lists both JWTAuthentication and SessionAuthentication so protected endpoints accept either a Bearer access token or an authenticated session cookie, letting API clients and browser/admin sessions share one endpoint surface.

nodes.label: Optional SimpleJWT Degradation
nodes.rationale: Registration still succeeds when djangorestframework-simplejwt is absent, but returns no tokens - the token issuance path is conditional on the library being installed rather than a hard dependency of the register flow.

nodes.label: Client Token Storage Guidance
nodes.rationale: Tokens should be held in memory or secure storage and localStorage avoided because it is readable by injected script if XSS occurs; refresh tokens warrant stricter storage than access tokens and should be rotated on logout, and access lifetimes kept short for sensitive flows.

nodes.label: RTL Arabic Document Shell
nodes.rationale: The document is declared lang=ar dir=rtl with a Noto Naskh Arabic body font, so right-to-left is the app's default direction rather than a toggled locale mode - layout and component styling throughout the frontend must be RTL-first.

nodes.label: React Compiler Opt-Out
nodes.rationale: The React Compiler is deliberately left disabled in this template because of its impact on dev and build performance - an explicit speed-over-auto-memoization trade-off.

nodes.label: Type-Aware ESLint Configuration
nodes.rationale: Production apps are advised to swap tseslint recommended for recommendedTypeChecked/strictTypeChecked with parserOptions.project wired to the tsconfigs, trading lint speed for type-aware rules.
